item.title: On the future
item.description:
Anatomy of a Future

Deconstruction

Imagine spawning on an empty plot of land, holding a highly detailed blueprint for a house. You were told to finish the house before the winter. This blueprint is rigid, but universally agreed upon: solid economic foundation, a family-ready environment and a solid roof that protects everyone from the outside world.

The deadline is non-negotiable.

You don’t own a shovel, you cannot pour concrete and cannot read schematic. Faced with the impossibility you sit in the dirt and stare at the empty space. Your house will never exist.

item.title: Quit Social Media
item.description:
Some Notes from “Quit Social Media” by Dr. Cal Newport @ TedxTyson

Cal is not on social media.

He claims that he’s been more successful than ever without social media. My goal is to investigate why.

Debunking Common Objections

1. Social Media is one of the most important technologies in the 21st century. Rejecting it would be an act of extreme Luddism.

That’s pure nonsense. It is not a fundamental technology, but they leverage off a fundamental technology (think of it as slot machines). It’s pure (unsavoury) entertainment, and nothing more.
